title.zh: 山脉数组中查找目标值

desc.zh: 用坡向定位峰顶，再按相反方向二分；证明最小下标与访问预算。
desc.en: Locate the peak by slope, then search both ordered sides within the access budget.

complexity: O(log n) time and get calls; O(1) auxiliary space

concepts.name: Mountain peak search
concepts.description: Derive the peak-containing interval from adjacent values.

concepts.name: Directional binary search
concepts.description: Search increasing then decreasing sides to return the smallest index.
